items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I went with Handy, I think Handy hired me then. ... I started playing with Handy.

ctx.x: Anyway we left off at the Entertainers, and then what happened after the Entertainers, after you played at the Entertainers? Is that the time when you got in with Peter Bocard? Oh, I see.
The years of that, I think I went with, uh, started preparing a little jobs in between, then I went with Handy, I think Handy hired me then. Went to La Vida?
Yeah, for La Vida, yeah. I started playing with Handy.
